text:
olivia: Heads-up — myna9b int4 canary started flapping today. Seeing OOMs during synthetic chat load when prefetch=8 and max_new_tokens default=512.

kai: logs? stack? sample request shape?

olivia: Pasting the failure snippet: ```
RuntimeError: GPU OOM while allocating KV cache (alloc failed)
model: myna9b-int4
seq_len: 2048
batch: 2
max_new_tokens: 512
prefetch: 8
```

sam: repro on my laptop with smaller seq_len: yeah frag + bursty microbatches. suspect slot fragmentation from large prefetch windows.

nate: Any latency regressions in nightly benchmarks? link in perf dashboard? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

perf-bot: nightly/2026-03-21: myna9b-int4 - p50 gen latency 42ms -> 65ms under sustained 120qps; mem headroom down by ~18% vs baseline int8 canary. https://perf.redwood/myna9b/2026-03-21

irene: Interesting — int4 kernel is denser but prefetch multiplier * seq_len kills slot reservation, leads to evict churn. Our defaults (prefetch=8) were tuned for 13b models, not 9b.

kai: Quick mitigation options: decrease prefetch to 4, reduce default max_new_tokens to 256 for myna9b, increase slot-reserve by 10%, or temporarily route to myna9b-int8 variant.

olivia: Can we try prefetch=4 + max_new_tokens=256 on a handful of nodes and run the canary again? If stable, roll out as default for this model.

sam: I pushed a canary config: ```
model: myna9b-int4
config_override:
  prefetch: 4
  max_new_tokens: 256
  slot_reserve_pct: 12
  kv_eviction_threshold: 0.65
```

nate: Running synthetic load now (seq 1024, bursty qps). Will watch OOMs and eviction rate.

perf-bot: canary-run 6451239900: mem headroom +9%, eviction rate down 40%, p95 latency increased +6% (microbatching artifacts).

irene: +6% p95 is acceptable vs OOMs. Prefetch drop reduces batching opportunity; we can compensate with adaptive microbatching (increase max_batch_size slightly).

kai: Also add fallback policy: if OOM rate > 0.5% over 5m, route to myna9b-int8 automatically. Keeps availability.

olivia: Good. Action items: Nate -> monitor canary for 2 hours and capture heap profiles; Irene -> run regression eval on quality (int4 vs int8) with new max_new_tokens 256 prompt set; Sam -> prepare rollback + fallback route.

nate: Acknowledged — starting 2h watch. I'll upload traces to /runs/myna9b/canary-6451239876 after.

irene: I'll run eval set now and post summary. If quality delta > 0.8% on BLEU/ROUGE we escalate.

sam: Created a small playbook note in the model onboarding checklist: "9b-class int4: prefer prefetch<=4, default max_new_tokens 256, slot_reserve >=12%, enable kv_eviction_threshold tuning" — link: https://wiki.redwood/models/myna9b/onboard

olivia: Thanks — once canary is green we can ship as model-defaults and add an entry in Optimize recommendations.

nate: First 30m: no OOMs, eviction rate steady ~0.02, p95 +5%. Uploading logs now.

perf-bot: artifact uploaded: https://perf.redwood/myna9b/canary-6451239876/artifacts.tar.gz

olivia: Great. Hold to monitor full 2h and then decide. :eyes:

kai: One more note — add a short test to onboarding smoke to run a 10-minute prefetch stress (prefetch=8) and fail the onboard if OOMs occur. Saves future surprises.

olivia: Agreed. We'll add that to the template.

sam: I'll open a small PR to the defaults repo with the myna9b overrides + the smoke test.

olivia: Perfect. Thanks team.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from kai, nate, irene)
